input.caption: Made my grandma's lemon cake today 🥹 you just beat 2 cups of sugar with 1 cup of butter, add 4 eggs one at a time, then fold in 3 cups of flour and the zest of 2 lemons. Bake it at 325 for an hour and glaze with powdered sugar mixed with lemon juice. Tastes like childhood!!
